items.q: Two angles are complementary. One is 38°. What is the other?
items.qAf: Twee hoeke is komplementêr. Een is 38°. Wat is die ander?

items.q: Two supplementary angles are in the ratio 2 : 7. Find the larger angle.
items.qAf: Twee supplementêre hoeke is in die verhouding 2 : 7. Vind die groter hoek.
items.explain: Supplementary angles add to 180°. There are 9 parts, so each part is 20° and the larger angle is 7 × 20° = 140°.
items.explainAf: Supplementêre hoeke tel op tot 180°. Daar is 9 dele, dus is elke deel 20° en die groter hoek is 7 × 20° = 140°.

items.q: Co-interior angles between parallel lines are (2x + 15)° and (4x − 15)°. Find x.
items.qAf: Binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tussen ewewydige lyne is (2x + 15)° en (4x − 15)°. Vind x.
items.explain: Co-interior angles add to 180°: 6x = 180, so x = 30.
items.explainAf: Binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tel op tot 180°: 6x = 180, dus x = 30.

items.q: When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, which pairs of angles are equal?
items.qAf: Wanneer ’n dwarslyn twee ewewydige lyne sny, watter pare hoeke is gelyk?
items.explain: Corresponding angles, alternate angles and vertically opposite angles are equal; co-interior angles add to 180°.
items.explainAf: Ooreenkomstige hoeke, verwisselende hoeke en regoorstaande hoeke is gelyk; binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tel op tot 180°.

items.q: Alternate angles between parallel lines are 2x and 5x − 60. Find x.
items.qAf: Verwisselende hoeke tussen ewewydige lyne is 2x en 5x − 60. Vind x.
items.explain: Alternate angles are equal: 2x = 5x − 60, so 3x = 60 and x = 20.
items.explainAf: Verwisselende hoeke is gelyk: 2x = 5x − 60, dus 3x = 60 en x = 20.

items.q: Co-interior angles between parallel lines are 4x and 2x + 30. Find x.
items.qAf: Binnehoeke aan dieselfde kant tussen ewewydige lyne is 4x en 2x + 30. Vind x.

items.q: An angle greater than 180° but less than 360°.
items.qAf: ’n Hoek groter as 180° maar kleiner as 360°.

items.q: The angles around a point add up to … degrees.
items.qAf: Die hoeke om ’n punt tel op tot … grade.

items.text: If two lines are cut by a transversal and the alternate angles are equal, the lines are [[]]. Co-interior angles between parallel lines add up to [[]]°.
items.textAf: As twee lyne deur ’n snylyn gesny word en die verwisselende hoeke gelyk is, is die lyne [[]]. Ko-binnehoeke tussen parallelle lyne tel op tot [[]]°.

items.explain: False. Vertically opposite angles are equal.

items.q: Two co-interior angles between parallel lines are 2x + 10° and 3x − 5°. Find x.
items.qAf: Twee ko-binnehoeke tussen parallelle lyne is 2x + 10° en 3x − 5°. Vind x.
